summary: Seven metres of roundabout kerb; nowhere to stop.
reasons: No room to pull out of lane

drivers.seclusion: Open junction; homes 28 m and further, but fully exposed to traffic.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb of the central island of a roundabout; no space to stop outside the traffic lane and shorter than a van.
drivers.convention: No parked cars anywhere around the junction.

flags: Low-lying: about 4.4 m, Toowong Creek 17 m away
sun_shade: Open to the sky; trees shade the north-east corner.
